title: Bound on the tester seed space
statement: Let $n>0$ and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits. The number of seeds in the circuit’s input consistency tester is at most $2^{3(q+1)^2}$, where $q=1+n+g$ and $g$ is the number of gates of $C$.
